meta.title: People Power The Budget
meta.author: Portland Public School District
meta.description:
Schools are people-centered organizations. That’s why about 84% of the PPS budget goes to staff — teachers, principals, bus drivers, custodians, instructional assistants, substitutes, and many more. The other 16% goes to everything else that keeps schools running: services, supplies, utilities, technology, curriculum, rentals, printing, travel, and internet connections. Staff costs also include benefits like compensation, pension contributions, health insurance, and other negotiated benefits. PPS has six labor union partners, and staff pay and benefits are determined during collective bargaining agreements with those unions. PPS contracts out only for highly specialized services and transportation. So when we say most of the budget goes to people, we mean it — because it’s people who power our schools.
